periods.label: Wed 16 Sep
periods.text: South to southwesterly 25 to 30 knots, reaching up to 35 knots offshore during the morning. 2.5 to 3 metres. Southerly 1.5 to 2.5 metres inshore, increasing to 2.5 to 4 metres offshore. Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers, with possible small hail offshore during the morning and afternoon.

periods.label: Wed 16 Sep

periods.label: Thu 17 Sep

Large and powerful surf conditions in the early morning are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing.
